title: Property & Vendor Management for Storage Sites
description: For the people who run a Greens site: the building is the product, and this course teaches how to keep it. The maintenance mindset and preventive schedules, every system and what fails, the lot and its paving, the trades and how a vendor is qualified, the one path from ticket to invoice, inspections and permits, budgets and capital planning, risk and incidents, and the vendor relationship kept clean. Course 7 of the Greens Storage Academy, for managers and assistant managers.
overview: The four jobs of property management and where the property lives in Nexus
Preventive, corrective and emergency maintenance, and a year of preventive work
Every building system, its early signs, the first response and the trade that fixes it
Asphalt, gravel, drainage, canopies, bollards and signs on a vehicle lot
The trades, the four vendor papers and the Compliance tab
The one path from ticket to scope, quote, approval, work, inspection and invoice
Inspections, permits, the fire cycle and the Records tab
Operating versus capital, the budget, service life and a Construction job
Vendor performance, contracts, the written trail and the ethics

questions.q: What does a storage site sell?
options: Units and spaces, whatever their condition
Space that is dry, secure and reachable; the building is the product
questions.explanation: The building is the product. A door that will not open or a lot that floods is the product failing in a tenant's hands.

questions.q: Which of these are the four jobs of property management? Pick all that apply.
questions.explanation: Rates and claims are the owner's decisions. The manager protects the asset, keeps it rentable, controls the cost and keeps the record.

questions.q: Where are a property's warranties, inspections, permits and AHJ contacts kept?
options: On the Records tab of the property in Asset Management
questions.explanation: The Records tab has seven collections, and a record with a date warns the Overview 90 days ahead.

questions.q: The same door latch has failed three times this year. What is the right response?
options: Keep fixing it; that is maintenance
Make it a preventive schedule, with the reason written in the schedule
Tell the tenant to be more careful
questions.explanation: Two of the same ticket is the signal. The third is a schedule with the reason written down.

questions.q: What does closing a preventive ticket do in Nexus?
options: Nothing until a manager reviews it
Writes the maintenance record on the property and moves the schedule on to its next date or reading
questions.explanation: The due occurrence files one ticket; closing it with a photo writes the record and moves the schedule on.

questions.q: A breaker in the RV row's lighting panel trips. You reset it and it trips again. What now?
options: Reset it again and tape it
Leave it off and call the electrician; a second trip is a fault
Swap the breaker from another slot
questions.explanation: Once is a reset; twice is a fault. Staff never open a panel.

questions.q: Who may adjust a roll-up door's spring?
options: Any staff member with a wrench
questions.explanation: A spring under tension is a wrist or an eye. Staff report it and never touch it.

questions.q: A bollard at the end of a canopy row is bent. What is right?
options: Straighten it with the skid steer
Replace it; a straightened post has lost its strength
questions.explanation: A bent bollard did its job. It is replaced, never straightened.

questions.q: A roofer offers a quick, cheap, cash fix. He has a license but his insurance lapsed over the summer. What do you do?
options: Take it; the price is good
Decline, and call the approved roofing vendor; no certificate, no vendor
Let him start and ask for the certificate later
questions.explanation: An Expired vendor does no work on site, however small the job. The certificate is a one-page PDF; if it cannot come, that tells you something.

questions.q: What does additional insured on a vendor's certificate mean?
options: Greens is named on the vendor's policy so it can claim on it directly when the vendor causes damage
The vendor's crew is covered by Greens
It is the same as workers comp
questions.explanation: Additional insured status is what lets Greens claim on the vendor's liability policy.

questions.q: Which of these are the papers collected before a vendor's first visit? Pick all that apply.
options: A certificate of insurance naming Greens as additional insured
A gate code for the vendor
questions.explanation: License, certificate, workers comp and W-9, plus references and a written scope. A vendor never gets a gate code, and a text is not a scope.

questions.q: Put the repair path in order.
questions.explanation: Ticket, scope, quotes, approval, schedule and work, inspect, close, invoice. Skip a step and the one after has nothing to stand on.

questions.q: A vendor arrives to service the gate. How do they get through the gate?
options: You give them the site's master code
Staff open it, or a visitor code that expires that day
They wait for a tenant to open it
questions.explanation: A vendor never gets a gate code. A vendor with a standing code can come at 2:00 AM.

questions.q: When may a ticket be marked Resolved after vendor work?
options: When the vendor says it is done
After you inspected the finished work against the scope, tested it and attached the photo
questions.explanation: Resolved comes after the inspection and the photo, never before.

questions.q: The fire inspector lists three deficiencies. What happens the same day?
options: Nothing; the notice comes by mail
A ticket per item with its deadline, then closure with photos and the notice filed in Records
A call to the vendor for the whole list
The items are fixed quietly and not recorded
questions.explanation: Raise a ticket per item the day of, close each with photos, and file the closed notice in Records.

questions.q: A vendor suggests skipping the permit on a new light pole circuit to save time. What does that tell you?
options: The vendor is telling you what else they skip; the licensed vendor pulls the permit and its cost is in the quote
questions.explanation: Electrical work like a new circuit usually needs a permit, and the licensed vendor pulls it.

questions.q: Which decision belongs to the owner, not the site manager?
options: Which approved vendor to call for a gate fault
Whether the work was done right
The capital plan: a new roof or a repave
questions.explanation: Capital, the budget, approved vendors, insurance and rates are the owner's; the manager runs the site inside them.

questions.q: A manager who signs for a $3,000 repair without asking is doing what?
options: Not the job; a manager who asks is doing it
Nothing wrong if the vendor is approved
questions.explanation: When in doubt, ask up. The approval limits are the control.

questions.q: Which statement about vendors in Nexus is right?
options: Vendors are kept in a list in Asset Management
A vendor is an Intacct vendor record reached through Accounting; there is no second list
Each site keeps its own spreadsheet
questions.explanation: Vendors are Accounting's. Nobody keys money into Nexus; what a vendor was paid is read from the books.

questions.q: Which kind of maintenance costs the most per hour?
questions.explanation: After-hours rates, no time to quote, and often a claim behind it.

questions.q: What is a floating preventive schedule?
options: Due on a fixed date each year
Due so long after the work was last done
questions.explanation: Floating schedules slip with the last visit, which suits lubrication and filters.

questions.q: Where does a meter schedule's reading come from?
options: Typed into the schedule by staff
The asset's own record, such as its hours or odometer; nobody types it twice
questions.explanation: Meter readings are read from the asset's record.

questions.q: Why does a preventive ticket refuse to resolve without a photo?
options: The photo is the proof the work was done; it is the record
The vendor needs it for the invoice
questions.explanation: Resolving a preventive ticket by any path needs a photo.

questions.q: A gate cycles slowly and grinds. What is the first response?
options: Open the operator housing and look
Clear the track, check power, and raise a ticket with video; never work on the operator
questions.explanation: Staff never work inside an operator housing or adjust a chain under tension.

questions.q: Why does a climate-controlled building keep a daily temperature log?
options: It is the answer to the claim that heat damaged a tenant's goods
questions.explanation: When a tenant claims heat damage, the log answers in one line.

questions.q: Who goes on a roof to look at a leak?
options: The manager with a ladder and a phone
Only someone with fall protection and the training, usually the roofing vendor
Any staff member on a dry day
questions.explanation: A ladder against a gutter is how managers get hurt. Ask the vendor to photograph it.

questions.q: Which three systems hurt most when they fail?
options: The gate, the doors and the roof
The office restroom, the dumpster, the Wi-Fi
questions.explanation: A gate that will not open closes the site; a door that cannot be secured cannot be rented; a roof fails into tenants' goods.

questions.q: What kills asphalt?
options: Sun drying it until it cracks, and water getting under it through the cracks
questions.explanation: Crack seal and sealcoat are the defense against exactly those two.

questions.q: Striping a vehicle lot should be done from what?
options: The management system's space map, checked afterward with a wheel
questions.explanation: A space that is 12x45 in Cubby and painted 12x40 on the ground is a dispute on move-in day.

questions.q: After the first heavy rain of the season on a gravel lot, what do you do?
options: Walk it before the vehicles come back; where water stood is where the grading goes next
questions.explanation: Standing water shows where the crown and the drainage have failed.

questions.q: A clear height sign on a canopy row was never re-measured after a canopy repair. What is the risk?
options: A rig that fits the sign may not fit the row; a torn-off air conditioner is a claim with the sign in the middle of it
The vendor will not come back
questions.explanation: Re-measure after any canopy work and replace the sign.

questions.q: Which trade owns a dead photocell on a light pole?
questions.explanation: Electrical owns panels, breakers, lighting and photocells.

questions.q: What does a W-9 have to do with a repair?
options: Accounting cannot pay a vendor it cannot report; no W-9, no check
questions.explanation: The W-9 is the tax form a vendor gives before it can be paid.

questions.q: A vendor's Compliance tab reads Expiring Soon. What do you do?
options: Ask the vendor for the renewal now and file it when it comes; the vendor may still work
questions.explanation: Expiring Soon may work; Expired may not. The managers are belled at 30, 7 and 0 days.

questions.q: Why share vendors across Greens sites?
options: A vendor serving nearby sites gives same-day response and a multi-site rate
Each site should have its own
questions.explanation: Ask the other sites who they use before adding a vendor.

questions.q: What is a scope of work?
options: One paragraph or document that says what is to be done, where, to what standard, by when, and what is excluded
questions.explanation: It is what the vendor quotes against, what you inspect against, and what the invoice is matched to.

questions.q: A $9,000 canopy repair is split into two $4,500 tickets to stay under the site's limit. What is that?
options: A limit avoided is a control broken; it is one job and needs the higher approval
Fine if both tickets are closed
questions.explanation: A job split into two tickets to stay under a limit is not two jobs.

questions.q: When does a vendor go into a rented unit?
options: Only with the tenant's written consent, or an emergency the manager approved with a witness and photos
When the tenant is late on rent
questions.explanation: The tenant has exclusive control of the unit.

questions.q: Who pays a vendor's invoice?
options: The site, in cash or on a card
Accounting, after the invoice matches the ticket, the scope, the quote and the inspection
The tenant whose unit was fixed
questions.explanation: The site never pays a vendor. It makes the invoice matchable in one look.

questions.q: What does an emergency skip?
options: The quotes, never the record; the ticket is raised during the call and the manager above is told the same day
questions.explanation: An emergency skips the quotes, never the record.

questions.q: What goes on every vendor invoice so Accounting can match it in one look?
options: The ticket or purchase order number
questions.explanation: Ask every vendor to put the ticket number on the invoice.

questions.q: What is an AHJ?
options: Any authority having jurisdiction: an agency with the right to inspect the property and require things of it
questions.explanation: A storage site answers to several; each is a record with a next visit.

questions.q: Which usually needs a permit?
options: A new electrical circuit for light poles
Replacing a photocell on an existing circuit
questions.explanation: Structural, electrical, plumbing, mechanical, sign and grading work usually needs one; like-for-like repair usually does not.

questions.q: An alarm panel is beeping the morning of the fire inspection. What do you do?
options: Silence it so the inspection goes well
Call the fire protection vendor; never silence a panel without calling, and never fake a record
questions.explanation: A false record is worse than a failed inspection.

questions.q: What is an open permit?
options: A permit whose work never passed its final inspection; a problem at sale, at refinance and at a claim
questions.explanation: The permit and its final go in Records.

questions.q: How far ahead does a record with a next date warn the property's Overview?
questions.explanation: Nothing on a storage site should lapse because nobody remembered.

questions.q: Which is capital, not operating expense?
questions.explanation: Capital replaces or adds something that lasts years; at Greens it runs as a Construction job.

questions.q: A budget line built as last year plus five percent has what problem?
options: No systems behind it; a line is a system and a number that can be defended
questions.explanation: Build lines from actuals, the schedules priced from vendor rates, and what you know is coming.

questions.q: What is the reserve?
options: Capital set aside over a system's life to replace it, so a roof is not a crisis
questions.explanation: Your record of age, tickets and photos is what gets a system funded from it.

questions.q: What does the site manager key into Nexus about a capital job's money?
options: Nothing; the money is read from the books by the job's Project-Job code
questions.explanation: Money is never keyed into Nexus. The site builds the case.

questions.q: Which budget number tells you the preventive schedules are wrong or skipped?
questions.explanation: Every emergency dollar is a preventive dollar nobody spent.

questions.q: Which risk does Greens' property policy answer?
options: A tenant's goods damaged by water
Storm damage to a roof or a rig into a canopy
A visitor tripping in a hallway
questions.explanation: Tenants' goods are the tenant's protection; a vendor's crew is the vendor's insurance; a visitor is the liability policy.

questions.q: A storm lifted roof panels. The roofer can replace them today. What is right?
options: Temporary protection only; permanent repair waits for the manager above you and, if it is a claim, the adjuster
Wait a week with no tarp
questions.explanation: A roof replaced before the adjuster saw it is a roof the carrier may not pay for.

questions.q: A vendor's truck cracks a block wall and the crew lead offers to just fix it. What do you do?
options: Photograph it, get the lead's name, write it in the ticket, raise a repair ticket and tell the manager above you; the claim goes through the certificate
Deduct it from the invoice yourself
questions.explanation: A quiet fix leaves no claim and no record.

questions.q: Which of these does a manager never say? Pick all that apply.
options: I am documenting everything and passing it to my manager.
Your insurance won't need to know.
Here is what I saw and photographed.
questions.explanation: Admitting fault, promising payment, settling at the counter and keeping an incident off the record turn a small claim into a large one.

questions.q: After an incident, when is the camera footage requested?
options: At the end of the week
The same hour, so it is saved before the system overwrites it
questions.explanation: Tell your manager which camera and which time the same hour.

questions.q: Which is a reason to buy a service contract rather than on-call work?
options: The trade is needed twice a year
The system has both scheduled visits and emergencies, such as the gate or HVAC
questions.explanation: A contract buys scheduled visits and a defined emergency response; read it once a year against what it delivered.

questions.q: What are the four things a vendor is scored on?
questions.explanation: From the tickets, twice a year, with the note on the vendor record.

questions.q: Where does a vendor relationship live?
options: In the tickets and the email or Teams thread, and on the vendor record
questions.explanation: A relationship in one manager's phone leaves with that manager.

questions.q: A vendor sends a holiday gift box to your home. What is right?
options: Decline, write it on the vendor's record and tell the manager above you
Keep it if it is under $100
questions.explanation: A gift is a quote you cannot question.

questions.q: Before dropping the gate vendor, what must be true?
options: Written feedback was given, a second vendor is qualified so there is no gap, the manager above you decided, and the old record stays with the note
questions.explanation: Never a gap in gate or fire coverage; nothing is deleted.

questions.q: What is a lien waiver?
options: A tenant's waiver of the storage lien
A vendor's signed statement that it has been paid and waives its lien on the property
questions.explanation: Received on construction jobs; Nexus never writes the wording.

questions.q: What does finaled mean for a permit?
options: Its work passed its last inspection
questions.explanation: An open permit is a problem at sale, at refinance and at a claim.

questions.q: What is hot work?
options: Welding, torching or grinding; a permit and a fire watch, never near stored vehicles
questions.explanation: Hot work near stored vehicles is how a lot burns.
